overview: The Medford Housing Authority Board of Commissioners accepted financial and audit reports, heard public input regarding resident storage, and approved annual operating plans and administrative resolutions.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the June 15, 2022 meeting.

items.title: Financial Reports
items.summary: Accepted agency-wide financial reports reflecting an operating surplus for the eight-month period ending May 31, 2022.

items.title: Public Input
items.summary: Matthew Page-Lieberman presented a resident petition requesting that basement storage spaces at 15 Canal Street be preserved rather than converted to an electrical room for a security upgrade.

items.title: Executive Director Report
items.summary: Executive Director Jeffrey Driscoll presented updates on the annual audit by Markham, upcoming capital projects, ongoing lease enforcement actions, staff turnover, and security improvements.

items.title: DHCD Annual Plan FY 2023 (Resolution 2022-032)
items.summary: Approved Resolution 2022-032 adopting the Medford Housing Authority's FY 2023 annual plan for state-aided public housing for submission to DHCD.

items.title: HUD Annual Plan FY 2022 (Resolution 2022-033)
items.summary: Approved Resolution 2022-033 adopting the FY 2022 annual plan for submission to HUD.

items.title: RCAT Program Waiver (Resolution 2022-034)
items.summary: Approved Resolution 2022-034 authorizing an application to waive participation in DHCD's Regional Capital Assistance Team program.

items.title: Weldon Gardens Equipment Replacement (Resolution 2022-035)
items.summary: Approved Resolution 2022-035 awarding a $207,706 contract to Enterprise Equipment Co., Inc. for replacement of rooftop makeup air units at Weldon Gardens.

items.title: Willis Avenue Fire Unit Rehab Contract (Resolution 2022-036)
items.summary: Tabled Resolution 2022-036 regarding a proposed contract with Egan Builders for fire damage rehabilitation at 20 Exchange Avenue pending price clarification.

items.title: Certificate of Final Completion (Resolution 2022-037)
items.summary: Approved Resolution 2022-037 issuing a certificate of final completion and final payment of $4,216.19 to MGS Construction Inc. for exterior replacement work.

items.title: Fair Housing Market Plan (Resolution 2022-038)
items.summary: Approved Resolution 2022-038 adopting the Fair Housing Market Plan required for the state CHAMP waitlist system.

items.title: Amended Language Access Plan (Resolution 2022-039)
items.summary: Approved Resolution 2022-039 updating the agency's Language Access Plan pursuant to state public housing notices.

items.title: Scheduling Special Meeting
items.summary: Scheduled a special meeting for July 20, 2022, at 9:00 AM to act on the tabled resolution and a Moving to Work application.
